name: API List

sources.title: Homepage — API directory run by apilayer
Add an API — submission form, 'reviewed within 24 hours'

requirements: Must be an actual API — the form asks for SSL support, authentication model, request/response formats, 'Official API?' yes/no
URL to the API's official site or documentation
Non-official/community APIs appear acceptable ('Is this an official API?' is a form field, not a gate)
No payment required; 'Sponsor Us' is a separate optional route
preparation: URL to official site or docs
Logo upload (auto-generated via Clearbit from URL+title, or upload manually)
Main category + optional comma-separated category suggestions
Technical facts: SSL support, auth model (API keys?), supported request/response formats (e.g. JSON)
Email (optional — used for approval notification and blog invites)
workflow: Fill the form — name, URL, logo, description, categories, GitHub/Twitter, API technical details
Submit; the site says APIs are reviewed within 24 hours
Approved APIs appear in category listings and the 'best APIs' newsletter rotation
watchFor: Fit is narrow: this lists APIs, not SaaS products generally — a SaaS without a public API doesn't belong
Site footer © 2019 — old codebase; the 24-hour review claim may be stale
Markdown in the description field — keep formatting simple
Registration exists (/register) but the add form itself doesn't appear to require an account
countsAsLive: The API appears as a listing card in apilist.fun category pages with a 'Read More' detail view and outbound link to the API site
unknowns: Whether submissions are still actively reviewed (site is apilayer-owned but dated)
Whether an account is actually required at submit time
